name: Multimeter, Amps
rules: Current is measured through the meter: break the loop and let the probes bridge the gap.
In A mode the meter is ~0.1 Ω. Across a part it steals the current; across the supply it blows its fuse.
Real meters have a separate socket for amps, for exactly this reason.
flavor: Everyone blows their meter's fuse exactly once. Most, twice.
